rate_and_timeout_policy.automatic_redirect_limitation: The initial collector followed redirects automatically. The only observed URL redirect in retained evidence was from www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/sitemap.xml to docs.cockroachlabs.com/docs/sitemap.xml, a different host with no other logged fetch. Redirect hops were not independently logged; the replay collector now paces and records each hop.
